d:
Every footprint, sighting and unexplained sound could bring the team closer to finding Bigfoot. But how much of the evidence can actually be explained? Join the Finding Bigfoot team as they examine reported encounters, investigate suspicious footage and break down the clues that keep the search alive. Could the next piece of evidence change everything?
Watch Finding Bigfoot, S2, Episodes 5, 7, 2, 1, 6, 8 & 3 on Discovery Channel India.
